```{r}
f      <- function(x) 1/(1+exp(-x))
qlogit <- function(p) log(p/(1-p))
clip01 <- function(p, lo = 1e-8, hi = 1 - 1e-8) pmin(pmax(p, lo), hi)
x_from_dose <- function(dose) log(dose/para$doses[length(para$doses)])
sigma_fun <- function(x,s0,s1) sqrt(s0^2 + (x^2)*s1^2)


beta_ab_from_mean_sd <- function(m, s, eps_k = 1e-3) {
  m <- clip01(m)
  ## 최대 분산 케이스: var ≈ m(1-m) (k → 0+)
  if (is.null(s) || is.na(s) || is.infinite(s) || s >= sqrt(m*(1-m)) - 1e-10) {
    k <- eps_k
    a <- m * k; b <- (1-m) * k
    return(c(a=a, b=b))
  }
  v <- s^2
  ## v = m(1-m)/(k+1)  ->  k = m(1-m)/v - 1
  k <- (m*(1-m))/v - 1
  if (k <= 0) k <- eps_k
  a <- m * k
  b <- (1-m) * k
  return(c(a=a, b=b))
}


fit_logistic_glm_approx <- function(doses, M_T, M_E, spec) {
  x      <- x_from_dose(doses)
  sigma  <- sigma_fun(x, spec$nsd, spec$nsd)
  lambda <- sqrt(1 + (pi/8) * sigma^2)

  ## ----- Toxicity: 기존과 동일 (평균만) -----
  M_T_fit  <- pmax(M_T, 0.05)
  mu_est_T <- qlogit(clip01(M_T_fit)) * lambda
  mT <- lm(mu_est_T ~ x)
  a0_T <- coef(mT)[1]; a1_T <- coef(mT)[2]   # 선형계수 (mu 파라미터)

  ## ----- Efficacy: m0, m1도 함께 추정 -----
  M_E_fit <- pmin(pmax(M_E, 0.005), 0.995)   # 극단값 방지
  eps <- 1e-8
  
  # clip01 <- function(p, lo = 1e-8, hi = 1 - 1e-8) pmin(pmax(p, lo), hi)
  # d0_E <- max(min(M_E), 0.01)
  # d1_E <- max(min(max(M_E) - d0_E, 0.99 - d0_E), 0.01)
  # # d0_E <- quantile(M_E, 0.1)
  # # d1_E <- max(1e-6, quantile(M_E, 0.9) - d0_E)
  # d0_E <- clip01(d0_E)
  # d1_E <- min(clip01(d1_E), 1 - d0_E - eps)
  # ## (3) 최종 b0, b1 추정 (닫힌형 OLS)
  # pstar <- clip01((M_E_fit - d0_E) / d1_E)
  # eta   <- lambda * qnorm(pstar)
  # cf    <- coef(lm(eta ~ x))
  # b0_E  <- unname(cf[1])
  # b1_E  <- unname(cf[2])

  
  # 1) 초기값 (plateau → m0,m1)
  m0_start <- max(min(M_E_fit-0.05), 1e-3)
  m1_start <- max(min(max(M_E_fit+0.05) - m0_start, 0.999 - m0_start), 1e-3)
  
  # logit-approx를 이용해 선형계수 초기값
  M_star   <- clip01((M_E_fit - m0_start) / m1_start)
  mu_est_E <- qlogit(M_star) * lambda #z의 mean 값 E[g(z)] 로부터E[z] 계산
  mE_lm    <- lm(mu_est_E ~ x)
  b0_start <- unname(coef(mE_lm)[1])
  b1_start <- unname(coef(mE_lm)[2])
  
  # 모델 함수
  f_E <- function(x, m0, m1, b0, b1, lambda) {
    m0 + m1 * f(b0 + b1 * x)
  }
  
  # 2) 1차 시도: nlsLM 있으면 사용, 없으면 nls
  # fitE <- NULL
  # if (isTRUE(requireNamespace("minpack.lm", quietly = TRUE))) {
  #   fitE <- tryCatch(
  #     minpack.lm::nlsLM(
  #       M_E_fit ~ f_E(x, m0, m1, b0, b1, lambda), #f is logistic function
  #       start = list(m0 = m0_start, m1 = m1_start, b0 = b0_start, b1 = b1_start),
  #       lower = c(1e-6, 1e-6, -Inf, -Inf),
  #       upper = c(1 - 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6,  Inf,  Inf),
  #       control = minpack.lm::nls.lm.control(maxiter = 500, ftol = 1e-10, ptol = 1e-10, gtol = 1e-10)
  #     ),
  #     error = function(e) NULL
  #   )
  # } 
  # fitE <- tryCatch(
  #   nls(
  #     M_E_fit ~ f_E(x, m0, m1, b0, b1, lambda),
  #     start   = list(m0 = m0_start, m1 = m1_start, b0 = b0_start, b1 = b1_start),
  #     algorithm = "port",
  #     lower = c(1e-6, 1e-6, -Inf, -Inf),
  #     upper = c(1 - 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6,  Inf,  Inf),
  #     control = list(warnOnly = TRUE, maxiter = 200)
  #   ),
  #   error = function(e) NULL
  # )
  # 
  fitE <- NULL
  # 3) 폴백: 재매개화로 unconstrained 최적화
  if (is.null(fitE)) {
    print("error 뜸")
    # 재매개화: m0 = logistic(u), m1 = (1 - m0) * logistic(v)  => 자동 제약
    # u0 <- qlogit(clip01(m0_start))
    # v0 <- qlogit(clip01(m1_start / (1 - m0_start)))
    p0 <- c(m0_start, m1_start, b0_start, b1_start)
  
    model_u <- function(par) {
      m0 <- par[1]; m1 <- par[2]; b0 <- par[3]; b1 <- par[4]
      # m0 <- plogis(u)
      # m1 <- (1 - m0) * plogis(v)
      f_E(x, m0, m1, b0, b1, lambda)
    }
    obj <- function(par) {
      r <- M_E_fit - model_u(par)
      sum(r * r)
    }
    opt <- optim(p0, obj, method = "BFGS",
                 control = list(maxit = 1000, reltol = 1e-10))
    d0_E  <- opt$par[1]; d1_E <- opt$par[2]; b0_E <- opt$par[3]; b1_E <- opt$par[4]
    # d0_E <- plogis(u)
    # d1_E <- (1 - d0_E) * plogis(v)
  } else {
    parsE <- coef(fitE)
    d0_E  <- as.numeric(parsE["m0"])   # Beta mean m0
    d1_E  <- as.numeric(parsE["m1"])   # Beta mean m1
    b0_E  <- as.numeric(parsE["b0"])   # 선형계수
    b1_E  <- as.numeric(parsE["b1"])
  }
  
  # 4) 최종 안정화: mean만 clip, 그리고 m0 + m1 <= 1 - eps 보장
  d0_E <- clip01(d0_E)
  d1_E <- min(clip01(d1_E), 1 - d0_E - eps)
  
  list(
    m0_T = a0_T, m1_T = a1_T,  # a0, a1 (Toxicity 선형계수)
    m0_E = b0_E, m1_E = b1_E,  # b0, b1 (Efficacy 선형계수)
    md0_E = d0_E, md1_E = d1_E   # d0, d1 (Efficacy Beta mean)
  )
  
  
}

fit_logistic_glm_approx <- function(doses, M_T, M_E) {

  ## ---------- 공통 준비 ----------
  x <- x_from_dose(doses)
  clip01 <- function(p, lo = 1e-8, hi = 1 - 1e-8) pmin(pmax(p, lo), hi)
  f <- function(z) plogis(z)  # logistic
  eps <- 1e-8

  # seed 계산에만 lambda 사용 (허용된 근사)
  sigma  <- sigma_fun(x, 1, 1)
  lambda <- sqrt(1 + (pi/8) * sigma^2)

  M_T_fit <- clip01(M_T, lo = eps, hi = 1 - eps)
  M_E_fit <- clip01(M_E, lo = eps, hi = 1 - eps)

  ## ---------- 1) TOX: (a0, a1)만 별도 최적화 ----------
  # seed: logit(M_T) ~ a0 + a1*x  (lambda는 seed용)
  zT <- qlogit(M_T_fit) * lambda
  a_init <- coef(lm(zT ~ x)); if (any(is.na(a_init))) a_init <- c(0, 0)
  a0_seed <- unname(a_init[1]); a1_seed <- unname(a_init[2])

  pred_T <- function(a0, a1) f(a0 + a1 * x)
  sse_T <- function(par) {
    a0 <- par[1]; a1 <- par[2]
    PT <- pred_T(a0, a1)
    sum((M_T_fit - PT)^2)
  }

  fit_T <- optim(
    par = c(a0_seed, a1_seed),
    fn = sse_T,
    method = "BFGS",
    control = list(maxit = 5000, reltol = 1e-12, fnscale = 1)
  )
  if (!is.finite(fit_T$value)) stop("TOX optimization failed.")
  a0_T <- fit_T$par[1]; a1_T <- fit_T$par[2]

  ## ---------- 2) EFF: (b0, b1, u, v)만 별도 최적화 ----------
  # 2-1) 초기 m0,m1 (min/max 기반), 그에 정합되는 b0,b1 seed 계산
  m0_seed <- max(min(M_E_fit - 0.05), 1e-3)
  m1_seed <- max(min(max(M_E_fit + 0.05) - m0_seed, 0.999 - m0_seed), 1e-3)

  M_star  <- clip01((M_E_fit - m0_seed) / m1_seed)
  zE <- qlogit(M_star) * lambda
  b_init <- coef(lm(zE ~ x)); if (any(is.na(b_init))) b_init <- c(0, 0)
  b0_seed <- unname(b_init[1]); b1_seed <- unname(b_init[2])

  # 재매개화: m0 = logistic(u), m1 = (1 - m0) * logistic(v)
  uv_from_m0m1 <- function(m0, m1) {
    u <- qlogit(clip01(m0))
    v <- qlogit(clip01(m1 / (1 - m0)))
    c(u, v)
  }
  c_uv  <- uv_from_m0m1(m0_seed, m1_seed)
  u_seed <- c_uv[1]; v_seed <- c_uv[2]

  pred_E <- function(b0, b1, u, v) {
    m0 <- plogis(u)
    m1 <- (1 - m0) * plogis(v)
    m0 + m1 * f(b0 + b1 * x)
  }
  sse_E <- function(par) {
    b0 <- par[1]; b1 <- par[2]; u <- par[3]; v <- par[4]
    PE <- pred_E(b0, b1, u, v)
    sum((M_E_fit - PE)^2)
  }

  # 시작점 생성: u,v만 jitter; (해당 u,v → m0,m1)에 맞춰 b0,b1를 매번 seed로 재산정
  make_jitter <- function(val, scale) val + rnorm(1, 0, scale)
  set.seed(1776)

  starts <- list(c(b0_seed, b1_seed, u_seed, v_seed))  # 기준 시작점

  for (k in 1:300) {
    u_k <- make_jitter(u_seed, 2)
    v_k <- make_jitter(v_seed, 2)
    m0_k <- plogis(u_k)
    m1_k <- (1 - m0_k) * plogis(v_k)

    # b0,b1를 m0_k, m1_k에 정합되게 재계산 (seed)
    M_star_k <- clip01((M_E_fit - m0_k) / m1_k)
    zE_k <- qlogit(M_star_k) * lambda
    b_init_k <- coef(lm(zE_k ~ x)); if (any(is.na(b_init_k))) b_init_k <- c(0, 0)
    b0_k <- unname(b_init_k[1]); b1_k <- unname(b_init_k[2])

    starts[[k + 1]] <- c(b0_k, b1_k, u_k, v_k)
  }

  best_E <- NULL; best_val_E <- Inf
  for (st in starts) {
    fit <- tryCatch(
      optim(
        par     = st,
        fn      = sse_E,
        method  = "BFGS",
        control = list(maxit = 6000, reltol = 1e-12, fnscale = 1)
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(fit) && is.finite(fit$value) && fit$value < best_val_E) {
      best_E <- fit; best_val_E <- fit$value
    }
  }
  if (is.null(best_E)) stop("EFF optimization failed.")

  b0_E <- best_E$par[1]; b1_E <- best_E$par[2]
  uhat <- best_E$par[3];  vhat <- best_E$par[4]

  # 제약 해석값 복원 및 안정화
  d0_E <- plogis(uhat)
  d1_E <- (1 - d0_E) * plogis(vhat)
  d0_E <- clip01(d0_E, lo = eps, hi = 1 - eps)
  d1_E <- min(clip01(d1_E, lo = eps, hi = 1 - eps), 1 - d0_E - eps)

  # 반환 (인터페이스 유지)
  list(
    m0_T = a0_T, m1_T = a1_T,   # Toxicity: a0, a1
    m0_E = b0_E, m1_E = b1_E,   # Efficacy: b0, b1
    md0_E = d0_E, md1_E = d1_E  # Efficacy: m0, m1
  )
}


get_prior_specs <- function(prior_id) {
  ## returns list(normal_sd=..., beta_sd0=..., beta_sd1=..., override_targets=FALSE/TRUE)
  if (prior_id == 1) return(list(nsd=2, bsd0=0.2, bsd1=0.2, override=FALSE, label="Weakinf"))
  if (prior_id == 2) return(list(nsd=4, bsd0=Inf,  bsd1=Inf,  override=FALSE, label="Noninf"))   # "max"
  if (prior_id == 3) return(list(nsd=4, bsd0=Inf, bsd1=Inf, override=TRUE, label="Wronginf"))
  stop("prior_id must be 1..3")
}

prepare_param_table_for_scenario <- function(scn, pars_list_by_prior,Ture_Val) {
  ## helper: 한 행 생성
  mkrow <- function(param, dist, TRUE_val,
                    c1_me, c1_sd, c2_me, c2_sd, c3_me, c3_sd) {
    df <- data.frame(
      Scenario = scn,
      Param    = param,
      Dist     = dist,
      TRUEE     = TRUE_val,   
      C1_mean  = c1_me, C1_sd = c1_sd,
      C2_mean  = c2_me, C2_sd = c2_sd,
      C3_mean  = c3_me, C3_sd = c3_sd,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
    names(df) <- c(
      "Scenario","Param","Dist","TRUE",
      "Cand1_mean(min,a)","Cand1_sd(max,b)",
      "Cand2_mean(min,a)","Cand2_sd(max,b)",
      "Cand3_mean(min,a)","Cand3_sd(max,b)"
    )
    df
  }

  ## --- Beta: δ0, δ1 (표에는 a,b를 Cand*_me, Cand*_sd로 기록) ---
  d0_a <- sapply(pars_list_by_prior, function(z) z$a0)
  d0_b <- sapply(pars_list_by_prior, function(z) z$b0)
  d1_a <- sapply(pars_list_by_prior, function(z) z$a1)
  d1_b <- sapply(pars_list_by_prior, function(z) z$b1)
  d0_me <- sapply(pars_list_by_prior, function(z) z$d0_mean_hat)
  d1_me <- sapply(pars_list_by_prior, function(z) z$d1_mean_hat)

  row_d0 <- mkrow(
    param="delta0", dist="Beta", TRUE_val=d0_me[1],
    c1_me=d0_a[1], c1_sd=d0_b[1], c2_me=d0_a[2], c2_sd=d0_b[2],
    c3_me=d0_a[3], c3_sd=d0_b[3]
  )
  row_d1 <- mkrow(
    param="delta1", dist="Beta", TRUE_val=d1_me[1],
    c1_me=d1_a[1], c1_sd=d1_b[1], c2_me=d1_a[2], c2_sd=d1_b[2],
    c3_me=d1_a[3], c3_sd=d1_b[3]
  )

  ## --- Normal: b0,b1,a0,a1 (표에는 mean, sd 기록) ---
  b0_me <- sapply(pars_list_by_prior, function(z) z$m0_E)
  b1_me <- sapply(pars_list_by_prior, function(z) z$m1_E)
  a0_me <- sapply(pars_list_by_prior, function(z) z$m0_T)
  a1_me <- sapply(pars_list_by_prior, function(z) z$m1_T)
  nsd   <- sapply(pars_list_by_prior, function(z) z$nsd)

  row_b0 <- mkrow("b0","Normal", TRUE_val=Ture_Val[3],
                  b0_me[1], nsd[1], b0_me[2], nsd[2], b0_me[3], nsd[3])
  row_b1 <- mkrow("b1","Normal", TRUE_val=Ture_Val[4],
                  b1_me[1], nsd[1], b1_me[2], nsd[2], b1_me[3], nsd[3])
  row_a0 <- mkrow("a0","Normal", TRUE_val=Ture_Val[1],
                  a0_me[1], nsd[1], a0_me[2], nsd[2], a0_me[3], nsd[3])
  row_a1 <- mkrow("a1","Normal", TRUE_val=Ture_Val[2],
                  a1_me[1], nsd[1], a1_me[2], nsd[2], a1_me[3], nsd[3])

  out <-rbind(row_d0, row_d1, row_b0, row_b1, row_a0, row_a1)
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  print(out)
  out
}


predictive_summary <- function(doses, pars_mean, nsd, delta_means, delta_sds, nsim=20000) {
  x <- x_from_dose(doses)
  ## Normal priors (linears)
  m0T <- rnorm(nsim, mean=pars_mean["m0_T"], sd=nsd)
  m1T <- rnorm(nsim, mean=pars_mean["m1_T"], sd=nsd)
  m0E <- rnorm(nsim, mean=pars_mean["m0_E"], sd=nsd)
  m1E <- rnorm(nsim, mean=pars_mean["m1_E"], sd=nsd)
  ## Beta priors (d0, d1)
  ab0 <- beta_ab_from_mean_sd(unname(delta_means["d0"]), unname(delta_sds["d0"]))
  ab1 <- beta_ab_from_mean_sd(unname(delta_means["d1"]), unname(delta_sds["d1"]))
  d0  <- rbeta(nsim,  unname(ab0["a"]), unname(ab0["b"]))
  d1  <- rbeta(nsim,  unname(ab1["a"]),  unname(ab1["b"]))
  ## 샘플 행렬(nsims x ndose)
  J <- length(x)
  T_samples <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=nsim, ncol=J)
  E_samples <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=nsim, ncol=J)

  for (j in seq_len(J)) {
    zT <- m0T + m1T * x[j]
    T_samples[, j] <- f(zT)

    zE <- m0E + m1E * x[j]
    E_samples[, j] <- clip01(d0 + d1 * f(zE))
  }

  ## 요약(mean,var)만 (파일 저장용)
  summ <- cbind(
    T_mean = colMeans(T_samples),
    T_var  = apply(T_samples, 2, var),
    E_mean = colMeans(E_samples),
    E_var  = apply(E_samples, 2, var)
  )

  list(samples = list(T = T_samples, E = E_samples),
       summary = summ,
       ab = list(d0 = ab0, d1 = ab1))
}
```

```{r}
run_from_scenarios <- function(scenarios, nsim = 20000, out_csv = "파라미터_PKPD.csv"){
  clip01 <- function(p, lo = 1e-8, hi = 1 - 1e-8) pmin(pmax(p, lo), hi)
  f <- function(z) plogis(z)

  plot_rows <- list()
  all_rows  <- list()

  for (scn in names(scenarios)) {
    pi_T <- as.numeric(scenarios[[scn]]$pi_T)
    pi_E <- as.numeric(scenarios[[scn]]$pi_E)
    x    <- x_from_dose(para$doses)

    ## (A) 시나리오별 1회: m0,m1 고정 추정 (spec 제외)
    fit_pars_once <- fit_logistic_glm_approx(
      doses = para$doses,
      M_T   = pmax(pi_T, 0.05),
      M_E   = pmax(pi_E, 0.05)
    )

    # 고정 m0,m1 및 선형계수
    a0_T0 <- fit_pars_once$m0_T
    a1_T0 <- fit_pars_once$m1_T
    b0_E0 <- fit_pars_once$m0_E
    b1_E0 <- fit_pars_once$m1_E
    m0_fixed <- fit_pars_once$md0_E
    m1_fixed <- fit_pars_once$md1_E

    ## === (A-1) 그래프용 "mean-only (variance=0)" 라인 추가: PriorID=1 ===
    # nsd = 0, delta 분산 = 0 가정 → 신뢰구간 없이 mean=lo=hi
    T_mean0 <- f(a0_T0 + a1_T0 * x)
    E_mean0 <- m0_fixed + m1_fixed * f(b0_E0 + b1_E0 * x)
    T_mean0 <- clip01(T_mean0); E_mean0 <- clip01(E_mean0)

    df_once <- tibble::tibble(
      Scenario = scn,
      PriorID  = 1L,
      Prior    = "Mean-only (nsd=0, var=0)",
      Dose     = para$doses,
      T_target = pi_T,  E_target = pi_E,
      T_mean   = T_mean0,
      T_lo     = T_mean0, T_hi = T_mean0,
      E_mean   = E_mean0,
      E_lo     = E_mean0, E_hi = E_mean0
    )
    plot_rows[[length(plot_rows) + 1]] <- df_once
    ## (B~G) prior별 처리
    pars_list_by_prior <- vector("list", 3)

    for (pid in 1:3) {
      print(scn); print(pid)
      spec <- get_prior_specs(pid)
      sigma  <- sigma_fun(x, spec$nsd, spec$nsd)
      lambda <- sqrt(1 + (pi/8) * sigma^2)

      if (isTRUE(spec$override)) {
        MT_fit <- seq(0.05, by = 0.02, length.out = length(para$doses))
        ME_fit <- pmin(MT_fit + 0.3, 0.999)
        m0_fixed<-0.1
        m1_fixed<-0.6
      } else {
        MT_fit <- pmax(T_mean0, 0.05)
        ME_fit <- pmax(E_mean0, 0.05)
      }
      
      MT_fit <- clip01(MT_fit)
      ME_fit <- clip01(ME_fit)

      ## (D) probit 근사로 a0,a1 및 b0,b1 재추정 (m0,m1은 고정값 사용)
      zT <- qlogit(MT_fit) * lambda
      a_cf <- coef(lm(zT ~ x))
      a0_hat <- unname(a_cf[1]); a1_hat <- unname(a_cf[2])

      Pstar <- clip01((ME_fit - m0_fixed) / m1_fixed)
      zE    <- qlogit(Pstar) * lambda
      b_cf  <- coef(lm(zE ~ x))
      b0_hat <- unname(b_cf[1]); b1_hat <- unname(b_cf[2])

      ## (E) pars_mean 구성
      pars_mean <- c(
        "m0_T"  = a0_hat,
        "m1_T"  = a1_hat,
        "m0_E"  = b0_hat,
        "m1_E"  = b1_hat,
        "md0_E" = m0_fixed,
        "md1_E" = m1_fixed
      )

      ## (F) Beta prior 파라미터
      d_means <- c(d0 = as.numeric(pars_mean["md0_E"]),
                   d1 = as.numeric(pars_mean["md1_E"]))
      d_sds <- c(d0 = spec$bsd0, d1 = spec$bsd1)
      ab0 <- beta_ab_from_mean_sd(unname(d_means["d0"]), unname(d_sds["d0"]))
      ab1 <- beta_ab_from_mean_sd(unname(d_means["d1"]), unname(d_sds["d1"]))

      pars_list_by_prior[[pid]] <- list(
        a0   = unname(ab0["a"]), b0 = unname(ab0["b"]),
        a1   = unname(ab1["a"]), b1 = unname(ab1["b"]),
        m0_E = pars_mean["m0_E"], m1_E = pars_mean["m1_E"],
        m0_T = pars_mean["m0_T"], m1_T = pars_mean["m1_T"],
        nsd  = spec$nsd,
        d0_mean_hat = unname(d_means["d0"]),
        d1_mean_hat = unname(d_means["d1"])
      )

      ## (G) predictive summary
      pred <- predictive_summary(
        doses = para$doses, pars_mean = pars_mean, nsd = spec$nsd,
        delta_means = d_means, delta_sds = d_sds, nsim = nsim
      )
      T_q <- apply(pred$samples$T, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), names = FALSE)
      E_q <- apply(pred$samples$E, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), names = FALSE)

      df <- tibble::tibble(
        Scenario = scn,
        PriorID  = pid + 1L,                    # → 2:4
        Prior    = spec$label,
        Dose     = para$doses,
        T_target = pi_T,  E_target = pi_E,
        T_mean   = colMeans(pred$samples$T),
        T_lo     = pmax(0, T_q[1,]),  T_hi = pmin(1, T_q[2,]),
        E_mean   = colMeans(pred$samples$E),
        E_lo     = pmax(0, E_q[1,]),  E_hi = pmin(1, E_q[2,])
      )
      plot_rows[[length(plot_rows)+1]] <- df
    } 
    tbl <- prepare_param_table_for_scenario(scn, pars_list_by_prior,c(a0_T0,a1_T0,b0_E0,b1_E0))
    all_rows[[length(all_rows)+1]] <- tbl
  } 

  out <- do.call(rbind, all_rows)
  readr::write_csv(out, out_csv)
  message("Saved parameter table to: ", out_csv)

  plot_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(plot_rows) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(T_target, T_mean, T_lo, T_hi, E_target, E_mean, E_lo, E_hi),
      names_to = c("Type","Stat"),
      names_pattern = "([TE])_(.*)",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Type = dplyr::recode(Type, "T"="Toxicity", "E"="Efficacy"))

  invisible(list(plot_df = plot_df))
}

```

# piror estiamte Test 
```{r}
######## Toxicity ########  

f  <- function(x) 1/(1+exp(-x))
x   <- log(50/350)

# Real value
m0 <- 0; s0 <- 10
m1 <- 3.5; s1 <-10 
mu <- m0+m1*x
sigma <- sqrt(s0^2 + (x^2) * s1^2)

# M = E(g[z]) Target 값 생성 
set.seed(1)
d <- rnorm(20000, mean = mu, sd = sigma)
M <- mean(f(d)) 

# estimate mu 계산 
mu_est <- qlogis(M) * sqrt(1 + (pi/8)*sigma^2)
M_est <- mean(f(rnorm(20000)*sigma + mu_est))

print(M)
print(M_est)


######## Efficacy ########  

# Real value
a0 <-0.5; b0<-9.5 #delta0
a1 <- 8.5; b1<-1.5 #delta1
m0 <- 1; s0 <- 10 #b0
m1 <- 5; s1 <-10 #b1
mu <- m0+m1*x
sigma <- sqrt(s0^2 + (x^2) * s1^2)

# M = E(g[z]) Target 값 생성 
set.seed(1)
delta0 <- rbeta(20000, shape1 = a0, shape2 = b0)
delta1 <- rbeta(20000, shape1 = a1, shape2 = b1)
d <- rnorm(20000, mean = mu, sd = sigma)
M <- mean(delta0 + delta1 * f(d)) 

# estimate mu 계산 
mu_est <- qlogis(((a1+b1)/a1)*(M-(a0/(a0+b0)))) * sqrt(1 + (pi/8)*sigma^2)
d_est <- rnorm(20000, mean = mu_est, sd = sigma)
M_est <- mean(delta0 + delta1 * f(d_est))

print(M)
print(M_est)
```

# Test 2 (모든 dose 에 대해서)
```{r}

f <- function(x) 1/(1+exp(-x))     
ref_dose <- 350
doses <- c(50,100,150,200,250,300,350)
x <- log(doses/ref_dose)

## 타깃값
M_T <- c(0.001101, 0.0158 , 0.049007, 0.123613, 0.235474, 0.368298, 0.5)
M_E <- c(0.050129, 0.054119, 0.080252, 0.163668, 0.318588, 0.49565, 0.634847)

## 고정 sigma
s0 <- 4; s1 <- 4
sigma <- sqrt(s0^2 + (x^2)*s1^2)

## efficacy용 delta (평균)
a0 <- 0.001015203; b0 <- 0.019288848  # delta0
a1 <- 0.017258443; b1 <- 0.003045608  # delta1
E_d0 <- a0/(a0+b0)      # = 0.05
E_d1 <- a1/(a1+b1)      # = 0.85

## 수치 안전용
eps <- 1e-8
clip01 <- function(p, lo = eps, hi = 1 - eps) pmin(pmax(p, lo), hi)

######## Toxicity (fit용으로만 0.05 하한 적용) ########
M_T_fit <- pmax(M_T, 0.05)                   # <-- 여기서만 깔아줌
mu_est_T <- qlogis(clip01(M_T_fit)) * sqrt(1 + (pi/8)*sigma^2)
fit_T <- lm(mu_est_T ~ x)
m0_T <- coef(fit_T)[1]
m1_T <- coef(fit_T)[2]

# 검증/재구성은 원래 타깃 M_T 기준
set.seed(1)
nsim <- 50000
M_T_est <- sapply(seq_along(x), function(j){
  z <- rnorm(nsim, mean = m0_T + m1_T*x[j], sd = sigma[j])
  mean(f(z))
})
RMSE_T <- sqrt(mean( (M_T_est - M_T)^2 ))

cat("### Toxicity m0,m1 추정\n")
print(c(m0=m0_T, m1=m1_T))
cat("\n[추정 모형으로 재구성한 M_T]\n")
print(round(M_T_est, 3))
cat("\n[타깃 M_T (주어진 값)]\n")
print(round(M_T, 3))
cat(sprintf("Toxicity 에러: %.6f\n\n", RMSE_T))

######## Efficacy (fit용으로만 0.05 하한 적용) ########
M_E_fit <- pmax(M_E, 0.02)                   # <-- 여기서만 깔아줌

## E[g(Z)] 타깃으로 변환 (0~1 내부로 안전클리핑)
M_E_star_fit <- ((a1+b1)/a1) * (M_E_fit - E_d0)  # = (1/0.85)*(M_E_fit-0.05)
M_E_star_fit <- clip01(M_E_star_fit)

mu_est_E <- qlogis(M_E_star_fit) * sqrt(1 + (pi/8)*sigma^2)
fit_E <- lm(mu_est_E ~ x)
m0_E <- coef(fit_E)[1]
m1_E <- coef(fit_E)[2]

## 검증/재구성은 원래 타깃 M_E 기준
set.seed(1)
M_E_est <- sapply(seq_along(x), function(j){
  d0 <- rbeta(nsim, a0, b0)
  d1 <- rbeta(nsim, a1, b1)
  z  <- rnorm(nsim, mean = m0_E + m1_E*x[j], sd = sigma[j])
  mean(d0 + d1 * f(z))
})
RMSE_E <- sqrt(mean( (M_E_est - M_E)^2 ))

cat("### Efficacy m0,m1 추정\n")
print(c(m0=m0_E, m1=m1_E))
cat("\n[추정 모형으로 재구성한 M_E]\n")
print(round(M_E_est, 3))
cat("\n[타깃 M_E (주어진 값)]\n")
print(round(M_E, 3))
cat(sprintf("Efficacy 에러: %.6f\n\n", RMSE_E))

```

```{r}

## =========================================================
## 재현 가능한 파라미터 적합 & 검증 (네 코드 그대로 함수화)
## =========================================================
fit_maxvar_params <- function(
  # 필수 입력
  f, doses, ref_dose = 350,
  M_T, M_E,
  a0, b0, a1, b1,
  # 고정 상수/옵션 (원래 코드와 동일값 유지)
  nsim = 40000,
  target_tau = 0.95,
  c_grid = c(1,2,5,10,20,50,100),
  # 재현성용 시드 (원래 코드에 맞춤)
  seed_fit_grid   = 1,  # c-grid 탐색에서 사용
  seed_check_T    = 2,
  seed_check_E    = 3
){
  ## 준비
  x <- log(doses / ref_dose)
  E_d0 <- a0/(a0+b0); E_d1 <- a1/(a1+b1)

  ## 비율식 적합 준비
  r_T <- qnorm(M_T)
  ratio_model <- function(par, x){
    a0p <- par[1]; a1p <- par[2]; b0p <- exp(par[3]); b1p <- exp(par[4])
    (a0p + a1p * x) / sqrt(b0p^2 + (b1p^2) * x^2)
  }
  obj_T <- function(par){
    r_hat <- ratio_model(par, x)
    sum((r_T - r_hat)^2)
  }
  lin <- lm(r_T ~ x)
  par0 <- c(coef(lin)[1], coef(lin)[2], log(1), log(1))

  fitT <- optim(par0, obj_T, method = "BFGS")
  alpha0 <- fitT$par[1]; alpha1 <- fitT$par[2]
  beta0  <- exp(fitT$par[3]); beta1  <- exp(fitT$par[4])

  cat("Base (alpha,beta) for Toxicity ratio:\n")
  print(c(alpha0=alpha0, alpha1=alpha1, beta0=beta0, beta1=beta1))

  ## c 선택 (Toxicity)
  set.seed(seed_fit_grid)
  pick_scale_T <- function(cval, M_target){
    m0 <- cval*alpha0; m1 <- cval*alpha1
    s0 <- cval*beta0;  s1 <- cval*beta1
    for(j in seq_along(x)){
      mu  <- m0 + m1*x[j]
      sig <- sqrt(s0^2 + (s1^2)*x[j]^2)
      z   <- rnorm(nsim, mean = mu, sd = sig)
      gj  <- f(z)
      mu_hat <- mean(gj)
      var_hat <- var(gj)
      bound   <- M_target[j]*(1 - M_target[j])
      if (abs(mu_hat - M_target[j]) > 0.01) return(FALSE)
      if (var_hat < target_tau * bound)      return(FALSE)
    }
    TRUE
  }
  c_star <- NA
  for (cval in c_grid){
    if (pick_scale_T(cval, M_T)) { c_star <- cval; break }
  }
  if (is.na(c_star)) c_star <- tail(c_grid,1)
  cat(sprintf("Chosen scale c* (Toxicity): %g\n", c_star))

  m0_T <- c_star*alpha0; m1_T <- c_star*alpha1
  s0_T <- c_star*beta0;  s1_T <- c_star*beta1
  cat("### Toxicity (a,b)~Normal params\n")
  print(c(m0=m0_T, m1=m1_T, s0=s0_T, s1=s1_T))

  ## 검증 (Toxicity)
  set.seed(seed_check_T)
  check_T <- sapply(seq_along(x), function(j){
    mu  <- m0_T + m1_T*x[j]
    sig <- sqrt(s0_T^2 + (s1_T^2)*x[j]^2)
    z   <- rnorm(nsim, mean = mu, sd = sig)
    gj  <- f(z)
    c(mean=mean(gj), var=var(gj), bound = M_T[j]*(1-M_T[j]))
  })
  check_T <- t(check_T); colnames(check_T) <- c("mean_hat","var_hat","M*(1-M)")
  print(round(check_T, 4))

  ## Efficacy: 평균을 g로 넘기기
  M_E_star <- (M_E - E_d0) / E_d1
  M_E_star <- pmin(pmax(M_E_star, 1e-6), 1-1e-6)
  r_E <- qnorm(M_E_star)

  obj_E <- function(par){
    r_hat <- ratio_model(par, x)
    sum((r_E - r_hat)^2)
  }
  fitE <- optim(par0, obj_E, method = "BFGS")
  alpha0_E <- fitE$par[1]; alpha1_E <- fitE$par[2]
  beta0_E  <- exp(fitE$par[3]); beta1_E <- exp(fitE$par[4])

  ## c 선택 (Efficacy) — 평균 유지 우선
  c_star_E <- NA
  for (cval in c_grid){
    m0 <- cval*alpha0_E; m1 <- cval*alpha1_E
    s0 <- cval*beta0_E;  s1 <- cval*beta1_E
    OK <- TRUE
    for(j in seq_along(x)){
      mu  <- m0 + m1*x[j]
      sig <- sqrt(s0^2 + (s1^2)*x[j]^2)
      z   <- rnorm(nsim, mean = mu, sd = sig)
      gj  <- f(z)
      d0s <- rbeta(nsim, a0, b0)
      d1s <- rbeta(nsim, a1, b1)
      Y   <- d0s + d1s*gj
      mu_hat <- mean(Y)
      if (abs(mu_hat - M_E[j]) > 0.015) { OK <- FALSE; break }
    }
    if (OK) { c_star_E <- cval; break }
  }
  if (is.na(c_star_E)) c_star_E <- tail(c_grid,1)
  m0_E <- c_star_E*alpha0_E; m1_E <- c_star_E*alpha1_E
  s0_E <- c_star_E*beta0_E;  s1_E <- c_star_E*beta1_E
  cat("### Efficacy (a,b)~Normal params\n")
  print(c(m0=m0_E, m1=m1_E, s0=s0_E, s1=s1_E))

  ## 검증 (Efficacy)
  set.seed(seed_check_E)
  check_E <- sapply(seq_along(x), function(j){
    mu  <- m0_E + m1_E*x[j]
    sig <- sqrt(s0_E^2 + (s1_E^2)*x[j]^2)
    z   <- rnorm(nsim, mean = mu, sd = sig)
    gj  <- f(z)
    d0s <- rbeta(nsim, a0, b0)
    d1s <- rbeta(nsim, a1, b1)
    Y   <- d0s + d1s*gj
    c(mean=mean(Y), var=var(Y))
  })
  check_E <- t(check_E); colnames(check_E) <- c("mean_hat","var_hat")
  print(round(check_E, 4))

  ## 결과 반환(필요한 것들 모두)
  list(
    x = x,
    params_T = c(m0=m0_T, m1=m1_T, s0=s0_T, s1=s1_T, c_star=c_star),
    params_E = c(m0=m0_E, m1=m1_E, s0=s0_E, s1=s1_E, c_star=c_star_E),
    alpha_beta_T = c(alpha0=alpha0, alpha1=alpha1, beta0=beta0, beta1=beta1),
    alpha_beta_E = c(alpha0=alpha0_E, alpha1=alpha1_E, beta0=beta0_E, beta1=beta1_E),
    check_T = check_T,
    check_E = check_E
  )
}

## =========================================================
## ---- 여기를 그대로 실행하면, 네 코드와 같은 출력이 납니다 ----
## (입력은 네가 준 그대로)
f <- function(z) 1/(1+exp(-z))
ref_dose <- 350
doses <- c(50,100,150,200,250,300,350)
M_T <- c(0.001101, 0.012313, 0.049007, 0.123613, 0.235474, 0.368298, 0.5)
M_E <- c(0.050129, 0.054119, 0.080252, 0.163668, 0.318588, 0.49565, 0.634847)

a0 <- 0.05; b0 <- 0.95
a1 <- 0.85; b1 <- 0.15

res <- fit_maxvar_params(
  f = f,
  doses = doses, ref_dose = 350,
  M_T = M_T, M_E = M_E,
  a0 = a0, b0 = b0, a1 = a1, b1 = b1,
  nsim = 40000, target_tau = 0.95,
  c_grid = c(1,2,5,10,20,50,100),
  seed_fit_grid = 1, seed_check_T = 2, seed_check_E = 3
)

## 최종 파라미터 개별 변수로 꺼내 쓰고 싶다면:
m0_T <- res$params_T[["m0.(Intercept)"]]; m1_T <- res$params_T[["m1.x"]]
s0_T <- res$params_T[["s0"]]; s1_T <- res$params_T[["s1"]]

m0_E <- res$params_E[["m0.(Intercept)"]]; m1_E <- res$params_E[["m1.x"]]
s0_E <- res$params_E[["s0"]]; s1_E <- res$params_E[["s1"]]

x <- res$x
```

# E 직접 근사 
```{r}
  M_E_fit <- pmin(pmax(M_E, 0.005), 0.995)  # 너무 극단값 방지
  eps <- 1e-8
  
  # 1) 초기값 (plateau → m0,m1)
  m0_start <- max(min(M_E_fit), 1e-3)
  m1_start <- max(min(max(M_E_fit) - m0_start, 0.999 - m0_start), 1e-3)
  
  # logit-approx를 이용해 선형계수 초기값
  M_star   <- clip01((M_E_fit - m0_start) / m1_start)
  mu_est_E <- qlogit(M_star) * lambda #z의 mean 값 E[g(z)] 로부터E[z] 계산
  mE_lm    <- lm(mu_est_E ~ x)
  b0_start <- unname(coef(mE_lm)[1])
  b1_start <- unname(coef(mE_lm)[2])
  
  # 모델 함수
  f_E <- function(x, m0, m1, b0, b1, lambda) {
    m0 + m1 * plogis((b0 + b1 * x) / lambda)
  }
  
  # 2) 1차 시도: nlsLM 있으면 사용, 없으면 nls
  fitE <- NULL
  if (isTRUE(requireNamespace("minpack.lm", quietly = TRUE))) {
    fitE <- tryCatch(
      minpack.lm::nlsLM(
        M_E_fit ~ f_E(x, m0, m1, b0, b1, lambda),
        start = list(m0 = m0_start, m1 = m1_start, b0 = b0_start, b1 = b1_start),
        lower = c(1e-6, 1e-6, -Inf, -Inf),
        upper = c(1 - 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6,  Inf,  Inf),
        control = minpack.lm::nls.lm.control(maxiter = 500, ftol = 1e-10, ptol = 1e-10, gtol = 1e-10)
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  } else {
    fitE <- tryCatch(
      nls(
        M_E_fit ~ f_E(x, m0, m1, b0, b1, lambda),
        start   = list(m0 = m0_start, m1 = m1_start, b0 = b0_start, b1 = b1_start),
        algorithm = "port",
        lower = c(1e-6, 1e-6, -Inf, -Inf),
        upper = c(1 - 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6,  Inf,  Inf),
        control = list(warnOnly = TRUE, maxiter = 200)
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  }
  
  # 3) 폴백: 재매개화로 unconstrained 최적화
  if (is.null(fitE)) {
    # 재매개화: m0 = logistic(u), m1 = (1 - m0) * logistic(v)  => 자동 제약
    u0 <- qlogit(clip01(m0_start))
    v0 <- qlogit(clip01(m1_start / (1 - m0_start)))
    p0 <- c(u0, v0, b0_start, b1_start)
  
    model_u <- function(par) {
      u <- par[1]; v <- par[2]; b0 <- par[3]; b1 <- par[4]
      m0 <- plogis(u)
      m1 <- (1 - m0) * plogis(v)
      f_E(x, m0, m1, b0, b1, lambda)
    }
    obj <- function(par) {
      r <- M_E_fit - model_u(par)
      sum(r * r)
    }
    opt <- optim(p0, obj, method = "BFGS",
                 control = list(maxit = 1000, reltol = 1e-10))
    u  <- opt$par[1]; v <- opt$par[2]; b0_E <- opt$par[3]; b1_E <- opt$par[4]
    d0_E <- plogis(u)
    d1_E <- (1 - d0_E) * plogis(v)
  } else {
    parsE <- coef(fitE)
    d0_E  <- as.numeric(parsE["m0"])   # Beta mean m0
    d1_E  <- as.numeric(parsE["m1"])   # Beta mean m1
    b0_E  <- as.numeric(parsE["b0"])   # 선형계수
    b1_E  <- as.numeric(parsE["b1"])
  }
  
  # 4) 최종 안정화: mean만 clip, 그리고 m0 + m1 <= 1 - eps 보장
  d0_E <- clip01(d0_E)
  d1_E <- min(clip01(d1_E), 1 - d0_E - eps)
  
```
